tasks.title: Runtime-backed evaluation scenario executor
tasks.outcome: The eval command launches controlled executable scenarios and captures real runtime events instead of relying only on prerecorded logs.

verification.expected_initial: named RED test is absent or fails before implementation

acceptance: A fixture executable emits provider, tool, tool-result, and assistant events that are captured without omission.
